estimate.explanation: Dockerfile has 18 lines with 5 layer-creating instructions (RUN/COPY/ADD). Each layer adds build-time memory overhead. Estimated runtime memory: 160 MB, CPU: 200m.

warnings.message: Using latest is prone to errors if the image will ever update. Pin the version explicitly to a release tag

securityIssues.suggestion: Review principle of least privilege and immutable tags.

securityIssues.message: Container runs as root: no USER instruction in final stage
securityIssues.suggestion: Create a non-privileged user and switch to it with USER before the entrypoint.
